evidence.quote: Our proposal keeps the class recovery separate from fees, with any fee reduction benefiting the class.
We propose a $38 million class fund, distributed automatically using Brightline’s records, plus $7 million in separately paid fees and expenses, subject to court approval.
we propose a $31 million class fund and $6 million in court-approved fees and expenses, with the same protective terms.
Brightline can settle now with a $30 million class fund and $5 million in separately paid, court-approved fees and expenses.

summary: Plaintiffs first raised fees in their opening term sheets, before any defense fee proposal. Fees and class relief were then negotiated concurrently over multiple rounds before the final class fund was accepted. The transcript does not clearly show a fee-for-relief tradeoff, plaintiff self-dealing, defense leverage of fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
